reason: Based on repository evidence, the plugin is primarily a user-facing web panel for usage monitoring: it adds a Usage tab to DeepSeek Harness conversation pages and presents real-time and historical session token/cost data, pricing breakdowns, status indicators, and export options. It also supports a custom price table and optional OpenCode Go quota lookup, so the core purpose is a navigation/monitoring UI panel rather than automation, code generation, or backend infrastructure tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面新增“用量”页签，实时展示本会话 token、费用与调用明细，并提供计价方式切换、模型价格配置与 CSV/JSON 导出。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Usage tab to the DeepSeek Harness conversation interface to show real-time and historical session token and cost details, with pricing options, custom price configuration, and CSV/JSON export.

capabilities: Collects and aggregates per-model call token and cost data for current sessions
Reads environment-provided keys for optional OpenCode Go quota lookup
Calls external OpenCode usage API endpoint for quota refresh
Writes a custom price file and provides local one-shot export download links

reasons.code: README describes a conversation-view tab named "用量" with live session usage, token splits, pricing modes, and export links.
README lists `/usage-api/*` routes and states OpenCode Go quota is fetched from `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` using env keys.
Readme notes custom price table persistence to `.dsh-usage-prices.json`; repo tree includes corresponding plugin files.
Package manifest includes DSH web client injection metadata and a plugin bundle patch entry, indicating UI integration behavior.
